faqs.question: Is the Eternal SBI Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining fee is ₹499 + GST and the annual fee is ₹499 + GST. The annual fee is waived when you spend more than ₹2 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the Eternal SBI Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You can request access through the Zomato, Blinkit or District app. SBI Card started issuing the card on 22 October 2026 and is rolling it out in phases.

faqs.question: What is the discount cap on the Eternal SBI Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The instant discounts on Zomato, District and Blinkit share one cap of ₹2,000 a month. Partner cashback is capped at ₹1,000 and cashback on other spends at ₹500.

faqs.question: Does the Eternal SBI Credit Card work on UPI?
faqs.answer: Yes, on the RuPay variant. Eligible UPI payments to merchants earn 1% cashback, within the ₹500 monthly cap on other spends.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the Eternal SBI Credit Card?
faqs.answer: It is 3.5% plus GST on foreign currency spends, so it is not a card to use abroad.
